title: corybas calophyllus
intro: Corybas calophyllus, commonly known as the Australian ground orchid or calophyllus corybas, is a species of terrestrial orchid. It is known for its unique properties and has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits. Corybas calophyllus is said to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, contributing to its therapeutic actions of soothing skin irritations, wounds, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Corybas calophyllus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is required to fully understand its effects.
